title: Free to Look, Free to Reason: Simple LLM Harnesses Outdiagnose Hand-Crafted Root Cause Analysis Agents
title_zh: 自由观察、自由推理：简单的LLM运行框架在诊断上胜过手工构建的根因分析智能体

paragraphs.en: Root cause analysis (RCA) of microservice failures has attracted many LLM agents whose investigation is hand-crafted, through standard operating procedures, fixed stages and role agents. Each is evaluated on its own data against few baselines, so it is unknown whether this design beats letting a capable model investigate on its own. We compare three simple harnesses that prescribe none of the model’s calls (one call over an evidence package, a SQL agent and the Codex coding agent) with five published LLM RCA agents and with statistical and causal methods on RCAtlas, 90 validated cases from eight public datasets, across six models and three reasoning efforts. The simple harnesses are the most accurate (PR@1 65–77% on three mid-tier models), ahead of the published agents (16–53%) and the non-LLM methods (6–39%), on every model on which both families were run. The published agents fix from a tenth to all of their model calls in the program, and a case study shows how these prescriptions skip the decisive evidence. A stronger model mainly improves reliability, a multi-turn harness mainly improves aptitude, and more reasoning effort changes accuracy by a few points at most while multiplying the time by up to seven. Among runs more accurate than the best non-LLM method, every Pareto-optimal run in cost or time uses a simple harness.
paragraphs.zh: 针对微服务故障的根因分析（RCA）已吸引了众多大语言模型智能体，但这些智能体的排查流程是手工设计的，依赖标准操作规程、固定阶段和角色化智能体。 每个系统都在各自的数据集上对照少量基线进行评估，因此这种设计是否优于让一个能力强的大语言模型自主排查，目前尚不清楚。 我们在 RCAtlas（来自八个公开数据集的 90 个经过验证的案例）上，将三种不规定模型调用方式的简单框架（单次调用处理证据包、SQL 智能体和 Codex 编程智能体）与五个已发表的大语言模型 RCA 智能体以及统计和因果方法进行对比，涉及六个模型和三档推理强度。 在所有同时运行了两类方法的模型上，简单框架的准确率最高（PR@1 在三个中端模型上为 65–77%），领先于已发表的智能体（16–53%）和非大语言模型方法（6–39%）。 已发表的智能体在程序中固定了从十分之一到全部的模型调用，一项案例研究展示了这些预设如何跳过决定性的证据。 更强的模型主要提升可靠性，多轮框架主要提升能力，而更高的推理强度对准确率的改变最多只有几个百分点，却会使时间最多增加七倍。 在准确率超过最佳非大语言模型方法的运行中，成本或时间上所有帕累托最优的运行都使用了简单框架。

paragraphs.en: Failures in the microservices behind web services cascade across components, and operators must find the root cause among hundreds of services, pods and nodes from metrics, traces, logs and events ( Beyer et al., 2016 ; Zhou et al., 2021 ; Dang et al., 2019 ) . Three lines of work improve this task: RCA methods, from statistical and causal ranking ( Lin et al., 2018 ; Wang et al., 2018 ; Ma et al., 2020 ; Li et al., 2022 ; Pham et al., 2024a ) to LLM agents; the LLMs underneath them; and general-purpose agent harnesses. A harness is the program around a model that feeds it data and carries out its actions. The simplest harness only feeds data, in a single call; richer ones let the model query the data, or write and run code as Codex ( OpenAI, 2026 ) does.
paragraphs.zh: Web 服务背后的微服务发生故障时会在各组件间级联传播，运维人员必须从指标、追踪、日志和事件中，在数百个服务、Pod 和节点之间找出根本原因（Beyer 等，2016；Zhou 等，2021；Dang 等，2019）。 有三条研究路线致力于改进这一任务：根因分析（RCA）方法，从统计与因果排序（Lin 等，2018；Wang 等，2018；Ma 等，2020；Li 等，2022；Pham 等，2024a）到基于大语言模型的智能体；这些方法底层的 LLM；以及通用智能体框架。 框架是指围绕模型的程序，负责向模型提供数据并执行模型的动作。 最简单的框架只在单次调用中喂数据；更丰富的框架则让模型可以查询数据，或者像 Codex（OpenAI，2026）那样编写并运行代码。

paragraphs.en: Published LLM RCA agents hand-craft the investigation with standard operating procedures, fixed stages, expert or role sub-agents and votes, so the program decides much of what is read and when ( Pei et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2024 ; Xu et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2024 ; Muhammad et al., 2026 ) . Each is evaluated against a few baselines on one to three systems, often collected by its own authors, and benchmarks run one reference agent or none ( Fang et al., 2026a ; Cai et al., 2026 ) . Whether hand-crafting still pays off as models and harnesses improve is therefore unknown.
paragraphs.zh: 已发表的LLM根因分析（RCA）智能体通过标准操作流程、固定阶段、专家或角色子智能体以及投票机制来手工设计调查过程，因此程序在很大程度上决定了读取哪些内容以及何时读取（Pei et al., 2025；Wang et al., 2024；Xu et al., 2025；Zhang et al., 2024；Muhammad et al., 2026）。 每项工作仅在一到三个系统上与少数基线进行比较，这些系统通常由其作者自行收集，且基准测试中要么只运行一个参考智能体，要么不运行任何参考智能体（Fang et al., 2026a；Cai et al., 2026）。 因此，随着模型和评测框架的不断改进，手工设计是否仍然有回报尚属未知。

paragraphs.en: We compare the three lines on the same cases. RCAtlas pools eight public RCA datasets into one format, screens 542 cases for validity and samples 90 across 23 scenarios. On it we run three simple harnesses that prescribe none of the model’s calls (one call over an evidence package, a SQL agent over the raw telemetry, and Codex), five published LLM agents, and statistical and causal methods, with six models, three reasoning efforts and one scorer. We change a method only where it cannot run on our data or has an implementation error.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在相同案例上比较这三条路线。 RCAtlas 将八个公开的 RCA 数据集汇聚为统一格式，筛选出 542 个有效案例，并在 23 个场景中采样出 90 个案例。 在其上我们运行三个不规定模型调用的简单测试框架（对证据包的一次调用、基于原始遥测数据的 SQL 智能体，以及 Codex）、五个已发布的 LLM 智能体，以及统计与因果方法，使用六个模型、三种推理努力程度和一个评分器。 仅当某个方法无法在我们的数据上运行或存在实现错误时，我们才会对其进行更改。

sents.zh: 我们在相同案例上比较这三条路线。

sents.zh: 仅当某个方法无法在我们的数据上运行或存在实现错误时，我们才会对其进行更改。

paragraphs.en: Harnesses that leave the model free to choose what to look at and how to reason win (Figure 1 ). The simple harnesses reach PR@1 65–77% on three mid-tier models, ahead of the published agents (16–53%), which are mostly ahead of the non-LLM methods (6–39%). The trajectories show why: when the program decides what to read, it can skip the decisive evidence, such as a log line or a service that stops receiving calls. A stronger model mainly improves reliability, a multi-turn harness mainly improves aptitude, and more reasoning effort changes little. Among runs more accurate than the best non-LLM method, every Pareto-optimal run in cost or time uses a simple harness.
paragraphs.zh: 让模型自由选择查看什么内容以及如何推理的测试框架（harness）表现更好（图1）。 简单的测试框架在三个中档模型上达到 PR@1 65–77%，领先于已发表的智能体（16–53%），而后者大多领先于非大语言模型方法（6–39%）。 轨迹显示了原因：当由程序决定读什么时，它可能跳过决定性的证据，例如某条日志行或某个不再接收调用的服务。 更强的模型主要提升可靠性，多轮测试框架主要提升能力，而更多的推理投入则几乎没有什么改变。 在准确率高于最佳非大语言模型方法的运行中，在成本或时间上帕累托最优的运行全部使用了简单的测试框架。

paragraphs.zh: 对简单测试框架、已发布的 LLM 智能体以及非 LLM 方法在同一批案例上进行的领域范围评估，涵盖六个模型和三种推理力度（第 6.1 节）；

paragraphs.en: Classical RCA for microservices ranks components from telemetry by statistical deviation (NSigma, BARO ( Pham et al., 2024a ) , ϵ \epsilon -Diagnosis ( Shan et al., 2019 ) ), causal discovery and inference (CIRCA ( Li et al., 2022 ) , RCD ( Ikram et al., 2022 ) , DyCause ( Pan et al., 2021 ) , FaultInsight ( Bi et al., 2024 ) ), propagation on dependency graphs (MicroRCA ( Wu et al., 2020 ) , MicroRank ( Yu et al., 2021 ) ), or multi-source fusion (TORAI ( Pham et al., 2026 ) ). LLM-based methods mostly fix the investigation in the program: standard operating procedures the agent must follow (FoA ( Pei et al., 2025 ) ), a controller that never sees data and an executor that writes code (RCA-Agent ( Xu et al., 2025 ) ), observation management with expert sub-agents (RCAgent ( Wang et al., 2024 ) ), voting among role agents (mABC ( Zhang et al., 2024 ) ), one agent per trace span (RCLAgent-V2 ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) ), tree search with self-reflection (LATS-RCA ( Naakka et al., 2027 ) ), or program-side retrieval followed by one LLM reranking call (DecompRCA ( Muhammad et al., 2026 ) ). Failure studies trace recurrent errors to the shared agent architecture rather than the model ( Kim et al., 2026 ) , catalogue reasoning failures across agentic and non-agentic prompting ( Riddell et al., 2026 ) , and contrast successful and failed trajectories ( Lu et al., 2026 ) .

sents.en: Failure studies trace recurrent errors to the shared agent architecture rather than the model ( Kim et al., 2026 ) , catalogue reasoning failures across agentic and non-agentic prompting ( Riddell et al., 2026 ) , and contrast successful and failed trajectories ( Lu et al., 2026 ) .
sents.zh: 失败研究将反复出现的错误归因于共享的智能体架构而非模型本身（Kim et al., 2026），梳理了智能体式与非智能体式提示下的推理失败（Riddell et al., 2026），并对比了成功与失败的轨迹（Lu et al., 2026）。

paragraphs.en: Coding agents have grown into general harnesses such as Codex ( OpenAI, 2026 ) and Claude Code ( Anthropic, 2026 ) : the model decides what to do next and acts by writing and running code, with no task-specific procedure. For RCA, such a harness without any RCA design already outperforms purpose-built agents on OpenRCA and RCAEval ( Huang et al., 2026 ) . OpsHarness ( Huang et al., 2026 ) then adds a self-evolving layer that learns from labelled past incidents of the same system. We take the complementary view: we test simple harnesses without such a layer (Codex, a SQL agent and a single call) against prescribed pipelines and non-LLM methods on the same cases.

paragraphs.en: Model-wide evaluations rank models on many tasks and sub-capabilities; the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index ( Artificial Analysis, 2026 ) has recently added an RCA-style task suite, ITBench-AA ( Sebin et al., 2026 ) , built from ITBench ( Jha et al., 2025 ) . RCA-specific datasets include RCAEval ( Pham et al., 2025 ) , OpenRCA ( Xu et al., 2025 ; Fang et al., 2026a ) , LEMMA-RCA ( Zheng et al., 2026 ) , the AIOps challenge data and RCA-100 ( Cai et al., 2026 ; Wen et al., 2026 ) , and a fault-propagation-aware TrainTicket benchmark ( Fang et al., 2026b ) . Each covers one to three systems, and each evaluates a narrow slice of methods: OpenRCA 2.0 runs one reference agent across models, AgenticOpsEval ( Cai et al., 2026 ) releases data and a scoring protocol without method results, and new methods are often evaluated mainly on data collected by their own authors ( Pham et al., 2024a ; Pham et al., 2026 ) . Audits show that simple rules or telemetry-free priors reach high scores on some of them ( Fang et al., 2026b ; Buljić, 2026 ) . paragraphs.en: Evidence from other domains questions elaborate agent pipelines. A fixed localise–repair–validate pipeline competed with software-engineering agents at a fraction of the cost ( Xia et al., 2025 ) ; splitting a task across conversational turns degrades LLMs mainly through lower reliability ( Laban et al., 2026 ) ; and input length alone can hurt even when retrieval is perfect ( Du et al., 2025 ) . More broadly, general methods that scale with computation tend to overtake hand-engineered knowledge ( Sutton, 2019 ) . We test this question directly on RCA.
paragraphs.zh: 来自其他领域的证据对复杂精细的智能体流水线提出了质疑。 一个固定的“定位—修复—验证”流水线以极小的成本与软件工程智能体相抗衡（Xia et al., 2025）；将任务拆分到多轮对话会主要通过降低可靠性使大语言模型表现变差（Laban et al., 2026）；而即便检索完全准确，仅输入长度本身也可能造成损害（Du et al., 2025）。 更广泛地说，随计算量扩展的通用方法往往会超越手工设计的知识（Sutton, 2019）。 我们在根因分析（RCA）上直接检验了这一问题。

paragraphs.en: The systems under test are microservice applications on Kubernetes. Their entities are services, the pods and containers that run them, the nodes (hosts) that run the pods, databases and middleware, and the operations a service exposes. Four kinds of telemetry are recorded: metrics , time series per entity such as CPU and memory use, request counts, error rates and latency (timestamp, entity, metric name, value); traces , one span per call between operations (trace and span identifiers, parent span, operation, duration, status), which reveal who calls whom and where errors and delays arise; logs , timestamped lines per pod with a level and a free-text message; and events , Kubernetes records such as restarts, evictions or scheduling failures. Each case also carries an inventory of entities and their relations (calls, deployment, placement).
paragraphs.zh: 被测系统是 Kubernetes 上的微服务应用。 其实体包括服务、运行服务的 pod 和容器、运行这些 pod 的节点（主机）、数据库和中间件，以及服务所暴露的操作。 记录四类遥测数据：指标，即每个实体的时间序列，如 CPU 和内存使用、请求数、错误率和延迟（时间戳、实体、指标名、值）；追踪，即操作之间每次调用对应一个 span（追踪与 span 标识符、父 span、操作、时长、状态），可揭示谁调用谁以及错误和延迟出现在何处；日志，即每个 pod 带有级别和自由文本消息的带时间戳的行；以及事件，即 Kubernetes 记录，如重启、驱逐或调度失败。 每个用例还附带实体及其关系（调用、部署、放置）的清单。

paragraphs.en: A case gives an incident’s flagged period, a period known to precede it, the candidate inventory and the telemetry of both periods. The method returns a ranked list of root-cause entities; we score the first five. Labels name one root-cause entity per case (three cases have two), at the level its dataset annotates: service, pod or node (we count databases as services and hosts as nodes).

paragraphs.en: Datasets label at different levels, and an answer may be finer than the label, such as a pod of the faulty service. Before matching, we therefore map each answered entity upward: it is replaced by itself and those of its parents in the inventory (container, pod, service) that lie at the levels the dataset annotates. Duplicates are then dropped, the first five distinct entities form the answer list, and they are compared with the labels by name. For example, when a dataset labels services, an answer naming a pod of cart counts as cart, and a second pod of cart further down the list adds nothing. Methods that rank metric columns, as most non-LLM methods do, are mapped the same way through the entity that owns each column. Each answer can match at most one root cause.
paragraphs.zh: 各数据集的标注层级不同，而答案可能比标注层级更细粒度，例如故障服务的某个 Pod。 因此，在匹配之前，我们将每个被回答的实体向上映射：它被替换为它自身以及其在资产清单中位于数据集所标注层级上的各上级实体（容器、Pod、服务）。 随后去除重复项，前五个互不相同的实体构成答案列表，并按名称与标注进行比较。 例如，当某个数据集以服务为标注层级时，回答中提到 cart 的某个 Pod 即计为 cart，而列表中更靠后的 cart 的另一个 Pod 不会带来额外增益。 对指标列进行排序的方法——大多数非 LLM 方法皆属此类——也以相同方式通过拥有各列的实体进行映射。 每个答案至多匹配一个根因。

paragraphs.en: RCAtlas pools eight public RCA datasets (ten suites, counting RCAEval RE1–3 separately) into one case format, screens every candidate case for validity, and samples the survivors across systems and fault types (Table 1 ; Appendix C.1 summarises the construction procedure).
paragraphs.zh: RCAtlas 将八个公开的 RCA 数据集（若将 RCAEval RE1–3 分别计算则为十个套件）汇集为统一的案例格式，对每个候选案例进行有效性筛查，并按系统与故障类型对存留案例进行采样（表 1；附录 C.1 总结了构建流程）。

paragraphs.en: The sources span nine systems, from Online Boutique, Sock Shop and TrainTicket to a bank, a telecom system and a cloud platform, with faults injected by chaos tools, by challenge organisers, or in drills on a managed Kubernetes service. Each case is converted to the same tables: an entity inventory with call, deployment and placement relations, and the metrics, traces, logs and Kubernetes events of a window around the fault, all in UTC. The conversion removes traces of the injection tools (for example their pods and log lines) so that no case reveals its answer.
paragraphs.zh: 这些数据源涵盖九个系统，从 Online Boutique、Sock Shop 和 TrainTicket 到一个银行系统、一个电信系统和一个云平台，故障由混沌工具、挑战主办方注入，或在一个托管 Kubernetes 服务的演练中注入。 每个案例都被转换为相同的表：包含调用、部署和放置关系的实体清单，以及故障前后一个时间窗口内的指标、追踪、日志和 Kubernetes 事件，全部采用 UTC 时间。 该转换会移除注入工具的痕迹（例如其 Pod 和日志行），使任何案例都不会泄露其答案。

paragraphs.en: The sources have released 2,359 cases; we screened 542 of them, and 348 pass eight exclusion rules. Among others, a case is excluded if its labels contradict each other, if it contains several faults, if the culprit is missing from the data, if neither a judge model nor an automatic check finds evidence of the fault in the telemetry, if data are incomplete, if the period before the fault is not clean, or if the fault starts late in the flagged window. The most frequent reasons are an unclean before-period (69 cases) and no evidence (56).
paragraphs.zh: 数据来源方共发布了 2,359 个案例；我们筛选了其中 542 个，有 348 个通过了八条排除规则。 除此之外，如果某案例的标签相互矛盾、包含多个故障、数据中缺失肇事原因、评判模型和自动检查均未在遥测数据中找到该故障的证据、数据不完整、故障发生前的时段不干净，或故障在所标记窗口中开始过晚，则该案例会被排除。 最常见的原因是故障前时段不干净（69 例）和无证据（56 例）。

paragraphs.en: From the 348 eligible cases we draw the 90-case core set (RCAtlas-Core): a minimum per scenario, then cases that diversify fault class, root-cause level, data kinds and telemetry volume. paragraphs.en: We run RCA-Agent ( Xu et al., 2025 ) and mABC ( Zhang et al., 2024 ) from their released code, and reimplement FoA ( Pei et al., 2025 ) , RCAgent ( Wang et al., 2024 ) and DecompRCA ( Muhammad et al., 2026 ) , which have no released code, from their papers; our DecompRCA reproduces the paper’s numbers on RCAEval RE1. The reimplemented agents share one set of data tools over the raw files. We follow one rule for fairness: fix only what prevents a method from running on our data or what is an implementation error, and add no capability. Examples are converting time zones for RCA-Agent, restoring modules missing from mABC’s release, and completing tool descriptions in FoA’s code agent; the appendix summarises the changes. We exclude RCLAgent-V2 ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) (about USD 0.9 and up to an hour per case), LATS-RCA ( Naakka et al., 2027 ) (its released search strips the agents’ tools), EviRCA ( Wang et al., 2026 ) and MicroRCA-Agent ( Tang et al., 2025 ) (each needs a hand-written adapter per system or is built around one benchmark’s data layout), and supervised methods, which need a labelled training split.

paragraphs.en: We answer five research questions. RQ1 (effectiveness): how do simple harnesses, published LLM agents and non-LLM methods compare on the same cases? RQ2 (mechanism): why do the simple harnesses win, and how much of each method’s investigation is prescribed by its program? RQ3 (capability and effort): how do a stronger model and more reasoning effort change how agents investigate and how accurate they are? RQ4 (aptitude and stability): how much accuracy is reproducible across passes, and how much appears only in some? RQ5 (cost-effectiveness): which model and method combinations are Pareto-optimal in accuracy against cost and time?
paragraphs.zh: 我们回答五个研究问题。 RQ1（有效性）：简单的测试框架、已发布的 LLM 智能体以及非 LLM 方法在相同案例上的表现如何比较？ RQ2（机制）：为什么简单的测试框架会获胜，以及每种方法的调查中有多少是由其程序预先规定的？ RQ3（能力与投入）：更强的模型和更多的推理投入如何改变智能体的调查方式及其准确性？ RQ4（能力水平与稳定性）：多少准确性可以在多次运行中复现，又有多少只在部分运行中出现？ RQ5（成本效益）：哪些模型与方法组合在准确性与成本和时间的权衡上是帕累托最优的？

paragraphs.en: Table 3 shows three layers. Averaged over the three mid-tier models, the simple harnesses reach PR@1 65–77%, the published LLM agents 16–53%, and the non-LLM methods 6–39%, against 5.5% for a random ranking. Codex is best overall, and even the weakest simple harness (one-shot) leads the best published agent (FoA) by 12 points. The lower two layers overlap: NSigma (38.9%) beats DecompRCA and mABC. Every LLM method is less accurate on pod- and node-level root causes than on service-level ones, and the published agents lose the most: from service to pod, Codex drops 9 points, FoA and RCAgent 31–38. NSigma is the only method more accurate on pods than on services (55.0% vs. 33.9%), since resource faults show on the culprit’s own metrics. Appendix C analyses the hardest groups. More kinds of data do not make a case easier. The 17 cases with all four kinds, which come from RCA-100 and ITBench-SRE, are the hardest for the simple harnesses (52–71%), and they form the only column in which a published agent matches the best simple harness: FoA reaches 70.6%, as Codex does. Conversely, the ten cases with metrics only are the easiest for the SQL agent (95.6%). The ordering does not depend on the model (Tables 5 and 5 ). On each of Luna, Haiku and Flash, every simple harness is ahead of every published agent (one-shot’s 5.9-point lead on Luna is not significant), and Codex is best or tied on every model it ran on. Across models, the simple harnesses fall into two tiers at the jump of the AA index from 34.5 to 45.1: 60–71% on Luna and Haiku, 74–87% on Flash, Sol and Astra. Leaving out MiMo (see below), 12 of the 13 cross-tier model pairs differ significantly, but only one of the nine within-tier pairs (Appendix B ). MiMo is the exception: its AA index (46.3) places it in the upper tier, but its accuracy (58–74%) matches the lower one, partly because it finished only 69–86 of the 90 cases.

paragraphs.en: The difference between the families is who decides what to look at and how to compute on it, which is what the prescribed-call ratio (Section 6.3 ) measures. The SQL agent writes its own queries and Codex writes its own analysis code, so the model chooses both what to read and how to compare it, and none of their calls is prescribed. The published agents fix part of this in the program. FoA can only choose among the steps of its built-in procedures, so when the matched procedure has no log step, it never sees the logs. RCA-Agent’s controller never touches the data and learns about the case only from its executor’s summaries, and mABC starts from an alert its program computes and walks the call chain from there. In the terms of our title, the SQL agent and Codex are free to look and free to reason; one-shot is free to reason over evidence that rules select.
paragraphs.zh: 这些家族之间的区别在于由谁决定看什么以及如何对其进行计算，这正是规定调用比例（第 6.3 节）所衡量的内容。 SQL 智能体自行编写查询，Codex 自行编写分析代码，因此模型既选择读什么也选择如何比较，它们的调用没有一个是被规定的。 已发布的智能体在程序中固定了其中的一部分。 FoA 只能在其内置过程的步骤中进行选择，因此当匹配的过程没有日志步骤时，它永远不会看到日志。 RCA-Agent 的控制器从不接触数据，只通过其执行器的摘要了解案例，而 mABC 从其程序计算出的告警出发，并从那里沿着调用链展开。 用我们标题中的术语来说，SQL 智能体和 Codex 既可以自由地看也可以自由地推理；one-shot 则可以对规则选出的证据自由推理。

paragraphs.en: The SQL agent starts from the symptom and follows “who cannot reach whom” to the root cause (Figure 4 , left). Its 31 queries reduce to six steps: it reads which tables exist (steps 1–7); counts failing calls by service and finds cart failing (step 12); searches the logs for error keywords and finds 1,291 lines in which cart’s connections to inventory are refused (step 14); queries inventory’s requests per minute and confirms that they fall from about 1,450 to 109 in the first 30 seconds of the fault and then to none; checks inventory’s pod logs and its place in the topology (steps 18–30, including an SQL error at step 17 that it fixes itself); and submits inventory (step 31).
paragraphs.zh: SQL 智能体从故障症状出发，沿着「谁无法访问谁」的线索追溯到根本原因（图4，左）。 它的31次查询可归纳为六个步骤：读取存在哪些表（步骤1–7）；按服务统计失败调用，发现 cart 服务失败（步骤12）；在日志中搜索错误关键字，发现1,291行记录显示 cart 到 inventory 的连接被拒绝（步骤14）；查询 inventory 每分钟的请求数，确认在故障发生的前30秒内请求数从约1,450降至109，随后降为零；检查 inventory 的 Pod 日志及其在拓扑中的位置（步骤18–30，包括在步骤17修复了一个 SQL 错误）；最后提交 inventory（步骤31）。

paragraphs.en: The SOP chosen by the program decides what is read. FoA fills in the fault description itself as “microservice incident”, which matches a generic SOP whose fixed steps never read logs; its judge declares the root cause found, cart, in the first round, after four calls of the controller (11 model calls in all). paragraphs.en: The framework walks down the call chain from the alert: the frontend-proxy ingress at 02:03, frontend’s POST, and its four callees. In that minute only cart’s AddItem still receives a call (one, failing); the other three receive none. paragraphs.en: Three points qualify these numbers. First, the one call of one-shot counts as a main call, because the model receives the whole task, whereas DecompRCA’s single call counts as prescribed, because the model only reranks a list the program has already narrowed. One-shot’s evidence package is still selected by rules (it keeps only metric series that moved), which is why the case study says the program decides what one-shot reads. Second, mABC’s records do not say which role made each call, so its ratio is a lower bound. Third, simply counting calls does not separate the families: the SQL agent makes 27 calls per case, the same order as the multi-step published agents (35–50), while one-shot and DecompRCA both make one.
paragraphs.zh: 有三点需要对数字加以限定。 第一，one-shot 的唯一一次调用算作主调用，因为模型接收的是整个任务；而 DecompRCA 的单次调用算作规定调用，因为模型只是对程序已经缩小范围后的列表进行重排序。 one-shot 的证据包仍然由规则选取（它只保留发生变动的指标序列），这也是为什么案例研究说程序决定了 one-shot 能读到什么。 第二，mABC 的记录没有说明每次调用是由哪个角色发起的，因此其比例只是一个下限。 第三，单纯统计调用次数并不能区分这些类别：SQL 智能体每个案例发出 27 次调用，与已发表的多步骤智能体（35–50 次）处于同一量级，而 one-shot 与 DecompRCA 都只调用一次。

paragraphs.en: Because the simple harnesses leave the investigation to the model, their accuracy rests on the model: it rises with the model’s tier (Section 6.1 ). We now ask how a stronger model and more reasoning effort change the investigation itself. Figure 5 compares three pairs of runs. A stronger model investigates less and finds more (contrast A): from Luna to Sol, both agents make fewer calls and query fewer entities (Codex 16% → \rightarrow 12%, SQL agent 21% → \rightarrow 12%), yet reach the root cause in more cases and gain 14–18 points of PR@1. More reasoning effort does the opposite (contrasts B and C, Luna medium to max and Sol medium to xhigh): agents make more calls and query more entities, but gain only 2–4 points of PR@1 (first pass of the SQL agent and Codex), at 1.5 to 4 times the wall time. Appendix B covers every effort level (Figure 8 ). In all three contrasts the runs query the root cause in two to five more cases out of a hundred (RC visited); the difference is what the model makes of it. Sol turns what it sees into a correct first answer, while a larger budget mostly adds queries that the model then does not use to change its answer. A larger budget buys exploration; a stronger model buys direction.

paragraphs.en: In operations, accuracy is not the only concern: an incident needs an answer quickly and at a sustainable cost. Figure 1 plots PR@1 against time and against cost per case. We count a run as usable only if it is more accurate than the best non-LLM method (NSigma, PR@1 38.9%), a threshold fixed before drawing the frontier, and draw the Pareto lines through all usable runs. Seven runs of published agents qualify (FoA, RCAgent and RCA-Agent, 43–63%), yet every run on either line uses a simple harness: each published agent is beaten in accuracy by a simple harness that is no more costly, and by one that is no slower. The DecompRCA runs, the cheapest and fastest of all, fall below the threshold (24–29%). The frontier gives three practical choices. When cost matters most, Luna with Codex reaches 68.9% for under one cent per case. When accuracy per dollar matters, Flash with Codex reaches 85.6% for about five cents. When the answer is needed quickly, Sol with the SQL agent answers in 45 s at 85.6%. The most accurate run, Sol at xhigh with Codex (88.9%), costs about 26 cents and takes 277 s per case, so the last few points of accuracy cost roughly five times as much as the cheapest strong setup.

paragraphs.en: Our study has five limitations. First, Codex is the only general-purpose coding harness we test; others, such as Claude Code, may behave differently. Second, all models are from 2026, so we cannot say whether the ordering holds for the weaker models for which many prescribed workflows were designed. Third, budget kept us from current frontier models such as Fable, Opus or Argon. Fourth, despite careful conversion and reimplementation, our datasets and methods may still differ from their originals; the appendix summarises the changes. Fifth, the case study follows a single case. The prescribed-call ratio extends its mechanism to all 90 cases, but it measures how much of an investigation is fixed, not that this fixing causes the lower accuracy; an ablation that lifts the prescriptions from one agent would test that directly.

paragraphs.en: For microservice root cause analysis, a capable model that is given the data and left to decide what to look at and how to reason outdiagnoses agents whose investigation is hand-crafted, and both mostly outperform statistical and causal methods. A stronger model improves accuracy and reliability; more reasoning effort adds little. Practitioners can start from a simple harness and pick the model and harness on the cost–accuracy frontier. Designers of RCA agents should compare against such harnesses on shared, validated cases, which RCAtlas provides.

paragraphs.en: Our results do not show that domain knowledge is useless. They show that fixing it into the control flow hurts when a procedure does not fit the case, as in our case study, where the procedure that FoA matched never read the logs. paragraphs.zh: 我们的结果并不表明领域知识没有用。 它们表明，当固定流程与具体情形不匹配时，将其固定到控制流中会带来损害，正如我们的案例研究所显示的那样：FoA 匹配到的流程从未读取过日志。 将流程作为可选指导提供给模型，而不是强制规定，是自然的下一步。

paragraphs.en: FoA (54.4 / 58.9 / 46.7) runs one of twelve SOPs written before any run after the examples in ( Pei et al., 2025 ) . In FoA the alert names the fault type, which selects the SOP; our setting withholds it, since it would reveal the answer, so FoA describes the incident itself. Luna then matches the generic Microservice Issue SOP (abnormal metrics → \rightarrow entry requests → \rightarrow traces) in 69 of the 90 cases; Flash, which more often guesses a fault type, does so in 33. Only four SOPs contain a log step (Memory, Network Loss or Partition, Code or Configuration Error, Database or Cache). FoA’s accuracy varies widely by fault group: on Luna 93% on application-code faults but 41% on resource saturation. RCAgent (54.4 / 50.0 / 43.3) prescribes 35% of its calls and, with FoA, comes closest to the simple harnesses on Luna; Luna leaves 7 cases and Flash 19 cases unanswered within its 30 steps. RCA-Agent (32.2 / 63.3 / 34.4): its released executor discards outputs above 16,384 tokens after two tries, which costs Luna, which prints whole tables, 16% of its executor steps (Haiku 3%, yet Haiku scores as low). DecompRCA (24.4 / 32.2 / 28.9): the program’s at most 15 candidates contain the root cause in only 57.8% of the cases, which bounds the model’s rerank. mABC (11.1 / – / 20.0) walks down the call chain from the alert, so a service that receives no requests is never reached. Luna also declares the cause undetermined in 42 of 89 cases, concentrated in sources with few or no traces (LEMMA 5 of 5, RCAEval RE1 8 of 9); Haiku answers 85 of 90.

paragraphs.en: The gap lies in where the evidence is. On resource saturation (34 cases) NSigma reaches 62%, close to one-shot on Luna (65%); on errors, outages, configuration faults and network breaks (33 cases), whose evidence is in logs, traces and events, NSigma and BARO reach 15% and 6% against 67% for the SQL agent and Codex on Luna. Three causes add to this. Many sources have thousands of series with about 15 pre-fault samples, half of them constant, so normal jumps outrank the root cause. NSigma and BARO score the largest signed deviation, so a drop ranks last (inventory’s request drop in the case study: 372nd of 373). Causal-graph methods cannot learn dependencies from tens of samples: RCD misses the root cause entirely in 71 of 89 cases.
paragraphs.zh: 差距在于证据所在的位置。 在资源饱和类（34 个案例）上，NSigma 达到 62%，接近 Luna 上一次性智能体的 65%；而在错误、宕机、配置故障和网络中断类（33 个案例）上，由于证据位于日志、链路和事件中，NSigma 和 BARO 分别只有 15% 和 6%，而 Luna 上的 SQL 智能体和 Codex 达到 67%。 三个原因叠加导致了这一点。 许多数据源包含数千条时间序列，而故障前样本仅约 15 个，其中一半还是常量序列，因此正常波动会排在根因之前。 NSigma 和 BARO 依据最大带符号偏差打分，因此下降会排在最后（案例研究中库存的请求下降排在 373 个中的第 372 位）。 因果图方法无法从几十个样本中学习依赖关系：RCD 在 89 个案例中有 71 个完全漏掉根因。

paragraphs.en: A paired bootstrap over the 90 cases (10,000 resamples, 95%) confirms the main gaps: the SQL agent and Codex beat the best published agent on every model they ran on, by 14 to 24 points (one-shot on Flash and Haiku only), and, with MiMo left out of the tiers as in Section 6.1 , 12 of 13 cross-tier model pairs differ against 1 of 9 within-tier pairs (with MiMo grouped with the lower tier by its accuracy: 20 of 21 and 1 of 14). The best published agent beats NSigma on Luna and Flash, but mABC falls significantly below it, so the family order holds for the strongest members.
paragraphs.zh: 对这 90 个案例进行配对自举检验（10,000 次重采样，95%）证实了主要差距：SQL 智能体和 Codex 在它们运行过的每个模型上都比已发表的最佳智能体高出 14 到 24 分（仅在 Flash 和 Haiku 上是一次性测试），并且，如第 6.1 节那样将 MiMo 排除在层级之外时，13 对跨层级模型组合中有 12 对存在差异，而层级内 9 对组合中只有 1 对存在差异（若按准确率将 MiMo 归入较低层级，则为 21 对中有 20 对、14 对中有 1 对）。 已发表的最佳智能体在 Luna 和 Flash 上胜过 NSigma，但 mABC 明显低于它，因此该家族的排序在最强成员之间依然成立。

paragraphs.en: Cases share entity and relation tables and UTC telemetry; labels and answer material are kept separate. Duplicate metric observations are collapsed, source attributes distinguish otherwise duplicate rows, and injection-tool entities, spans, logs and events are removed. Source fault windows are retained where available; RCA-100 adds 20 minutes before the alert, and sources giving only an injection time use an initial before-period and flag the remainder without exposing the onset. Automatic checks cover label consistency, culprit coverage, fault timing, completeness, shortcuts and observable evidence. Claude Sonnet 5.5 reviews labels, check results, row counts and the twelve most-changed series; ITBench-SRE uses automatic checks only. Exclusions are contradictory labels (8), multiple faults outside the multi-fault scenario (20), a missing culprit or its data (14), no evidence (56), incomplete data (38), failure of the multi-fault pre-filter (5), an unclean before-period or nearby fault (69), and less than a third of the window remaining after the fault (37); rules overlap. Of 542 screened cases, 348 remain. RCAEval supplies three cases per sub-suite (27); other scenarios supply at least three where eligible. Remaining places diversify scenario, fault class, root-cause level, data kinds, volume and clue coverage, with fixed tie-breaking and seed, before method runs.

paragraphs.en: The prompt includes instructions, the question, recorded and flagged periods, all selected evidence and the scenario’s answer template, with neutral item titles. S1 gives the incident record, inventory, topology, placement and coverage. S2 supplies moved metrics as raw samples: using the before-period median and robust spread (MAD × 1.4826 \times 1.4826 ), a series needs a change score max ⁡ ( median shift , 0.6 × largest departure ) ≥ 4 \max(\text{median shift},0.6\times\text{largest departure})\geq 4 spreads, plus a median shift of at least 10% or a departure of at least 20% of the baseline level. Identical series are collapsed; unlabelled duplicate-row series are omitted. At most 120 series are selected in turns across moving entities and rendered on the source time grid, with missing samples marked. S3 gives per-minute entry requests, errors, duration quantiles and caller–callee statistics, including missing downstream spans. S4 groups logs into masked templates: the 30 most-changed entities receive separate items, with up to eight templates and twelve raw lines per entity, prioritising errors, warnings and new templates. S5 groups Kubernetes events by object and reason (at most 60 groups). Constant series are counted only; series beyond the cap, full raw traces and logs, injection traces and answer material are omitted. The case study contains 136 items (about 75k tokens); no one-shot prompt was truncated.
paragraphs.zh: 提示词包含指令、问题、记录并标记的时段、所有已选定的证据以及场景的答案模板，条目标题采用中性表述。 S1 给出事件记录、清单、拓扑、部署位置与覆盖率。 S2 以原始样本形式提供变动指标：使用前一时段的中位数和稳健离散度（MAD × 1.4826 \times 1.4826 ），一个序列需要满足变化分数 max ⁡ ( median shift , 0.6 × largest departure ) ≥ 4 \max(\text{median shift},0.6\times\text{largest departure})\geq 4 个离散度，且中位数偏移至少 10% 或偏移量至少达到基线水平的 20%。 相同的序列会被合并；未标注的重复行序列会被省略。 最多选取 120 个序列，在移动实体之间轮流选取，并渲染到源时间网格上，缺失的样本会被标记。 S3 给出每分钟的进入请求、错误、时延分位数以及调用方与被调用方统计，包括缺失的下游 span。 S4 将日志归并为掩码模板：变化最大的 30 个实体各获得独立条目，每个实体最多八条模板和十二条原始日志行，优先保留错误、警告和新模板。 S5 按对象和原因对 Kubernetes 事件分组（最多 60 组）。 恒定序列仅统计数量；超出上限的序列、完整原始追踪和日志、注入追踪以及答案材料均被省略。 该案例研究包含 136 个条目（约 7.5 万 token）；没有任何单次提示词被截断。

paragraphs.en: LLM methods run without generation parameters (except effort in Setting 3), one hour per case, first five answers scored. Interface fixes: shared raw-data tools for FoA, RCAgent and mABC; complete tool descriptions for FoA’s code agent; UTC+8 times for RCA-Agent; modules missing from mABC’s release, a loop limit, a cut at “Observation” and a format hint; resampling for TORAI; missing functions for FaultInsight. Setting differences: no temperatures; RCAgent’s expert also reads metrics and traces (at most 30 steps); mABC’s alert on the entry service’s requests. The SQL agent differs from the reference agent of ( Fang et al., 2026a ) in temperature, an optional think tool, its answer format, and the topology files that every case folder carries.

paragraphs.en: On node-level faults the agents mention the true node in 85–90% of runs but mostly blame a pod or service on it. Three AIOps 2022 cases fail for reasons in the data: no clear metric on the faulty node, a fault that leaves almost no trace, and an unlabelled burst on another node. No one-shot prompt was truncated; cases with all four data kinds have a median of 115k tokens.
paragraphs.zh: 在节点级故障中，智能体在 85–90% 的运行中提到了真正的故障节点，但大多将原因归咎于该节点上的某个 Pod 或服务。 三个 AIOps 2022 用例因数据本身的原因而失败：故障节点上没有明确的指标、某个故障几乎不留任何痕迹，以及另一节点上未标注的突发流量。 没有任何单次（one-shot）提示被截断；包含全部四类数据的用例中位数为 115k 个词元。
